benchmark.note: Benchmark executed against TARGET_URL=http://localhost:3001/api/v1. Backend not running locally; all requests failed. Measurements are included to show harness behavior and should be re-run against a staging URL.

pwa.notes: Manifest, icons and service worker exist. Service worker ignores API and caches shell. Offline queue logic is implemented in the frontend but runtime verification is blocked without backend. Installability requires secure context/production registration.

offline.notes: Frontend enqueues transactions with a reference_number; backend deduplicates by reference_number. End-to-end flush/retry tests require running backend and test DB.

mobile_responsive.notes: Responsive components and hooks exist; only browser/emulation checks are possible locally.
